opening.first_sentence: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling from Freya Bank.

questions.ask: what is your date of birth?
what are the last four digits of your phone number?

identity.first_line: Thank you. Before we continue I need to check two security questions. First, what is your date of birth?

hints.day_month_swapped: Ask the customer to repeat the date of birth, saying the month as a word.

on_failed.say: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity, so I cannot continue this call.

on_declined.counts_as_declining: refusing to answer after the explanation

debt_statement: I'm calling about late payments on your accounts with Freya Bank.
first_ask: Can you pay the full amount today?
first_ask_all: Can you pay all of them today?

floor_offer.say_with_offer: the rest of the amount stays due

deceased.say: I'm very sorry for your loss.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: the customer asks to restructure the debt or for a payment plan
special_cases.action: transfer to the restructuring queue; promises already recorded stay, promises agreed but not recorded are not recorded; add no notes

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: the customer asks for a human
special_cases.action: transfer to the general queue; add no notes

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.action: note that product with reason dispute and continue with the other products

special_cases.name: paid
special_cases.trigger: the customer says one product is already paid
special_cases.action: note that product with reason paid and continue with the other products

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: the customer says they cannot pay one product because of hardship
special_cases.action: note that product with reason hardship and continue with the other products

sentences.after_promise: Thank you, your payment promise is recorded.

robot_question: Say honestly that you are an automated assistant of Freya Bank.
scam_question: Say the customer can call Freya Bank on the number on their card to check this call is genuine; never ask for card numbers or passwords.
gaps: Brief A is not in input/: opening sentence, forbidden words, identity order and limits, calendar holidays, bands and deadlines, persuasion attempts (rule 30), callback window, special cases (rule 41), outcome reasons and required sentences are placeholders chosen as safe defaults, not brief values
call variable names taken from docs/api.md example (customer_id, first_name, last_name, title, now)
